ruleDefinitions.name: Regedit as Trusted Installer
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a regedit started with TrustedInstaller privileges or by ProcessHacker.exe

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\regedit\\\.exe$") AND (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\TrustedInstaller\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\ProcessHacker\\\.exe$")))
